title: storefront.enquiry.whatsapp_opted_in
description: A buyer ticked the enquiry form's WhatsApp marketing opt-in (ENGAGE-02). Staged in the same transaction as the enquiry by services/storefront/app/services.py:create_enquiry_for_store. Carries the id only: the buyer's number is sealed PII and never travels on an event. Consumed by notification (`consumers.record_storefront_opt_in`), which reads the number through storefront's audited `GET /internal/v1/enquiries/{id}/whatsapp-opt-in` and records an `opted_in` whatsapp/marketing consent event with source `storefront_enquiry`. The envelope's `organization_id` and `occurred_at` are authoritative.
